characters.name: The Widow’s Son
characters.description: A poor boy driven out to earn his bread, whose dangerous curiosity leads him into forbidden rooms, and whose courage and cunning let him live as a ragged gardener by day and a mysterious armored champion in war.
characters.look: A slim, kind-faced young man of about nineteen with milk-pale skin and bright red cheeks, an oval face, a neat, narrow nose, big dark-brown eyes under thick level black eyebrows and short, glossy blue-black hair, wavy on top, with a stubborn cowlick sticking up at the crown. He wears a faded cornflower-blue sleeveless jerkin with three wooden toggles over a coarse oatmeal smock, a small red neckerchief, mended charcoal homespun trousers tied at the ankle and scuffed brown ankle boots.

characters.name: The Garden Boy in the Lichen Wig
characters.description: The widow’s son in disguise. With a scruffy wig of grey spruce lichen on his head, nobody at the King’s manor knows him, so he digs in the garden and sleeps under the summerhouse steps.
characters.look: A slim young man of about nineteen with milk-pale skin, bright red cheeks, an oval face, a neat, narrow nose, big dark-brown eyes and thick level black eyebrows, whose hair is completely hidden under a huge, shaggy wig of pale grey-green beard lichen from old spruces that hangs in long, wispy, tangled strands over his ears, neck and forehead, so he looks wretched and scruffy. He wears a faded cornflower-blue sleeveless jerkin, a torn oatmeal smock, a small red neckerchief, earth-stained charcoal trousers and scuffed brown ankle boots.

characters.name: The Strange Champion
characters.description: The widow’s son in the rustiest armour from the troll’s house. He rides out on the black horse whenever the King is in trouble, and nobody guesses who he is.
characters.look: A slim young man of about nineteen with milk-pale skin, bright red cheeks, an oval face, a neat, narrow nose, big dark-brown eyes under thick level black eyebrows and a lock of glossy blue-black hair on his forehead, clad in an old suit of plate armour blotched all over with orange-brown rust: a dented breastplate, jointed rusty arm and leg plates, a rusty mail collar and a round rusty helmet with the visor pushed up. A rusty sword with a plain cross hilt hangs from a cracked leather belt.

characters.name: The Young King
characters.description: The widow’s son once he has won the Princess and half the kingdom. He would give the black horse anything it wanted, except what it asks for.
characters.look: A slim young king of about twenty with milk-pale skin, bright red cheeks, an oval face, a neat, narrow nose, big dark-brown eyes under thick level black eyebrows and short, glossy blue-black hair, wavy on top, with a cowlick at the crown. He wears a small, plain gold crown, a long cornflower-blue robe bordered with golden leaves, a small red neckerchief, a cream mantle pinned at one shoulder with a round gold brooch, and red-brown riding boots.

characters.name: The Black Horse (Enchanted Prince)
characters.description: A great black horse bound to a troll, wise and commanding, who guides the boy to magic tools and strength, and later reveals himself as a prince freed from enchantment.
characters.look: A big, powerful, coal-black horse with a glossy coat and no white markings at all, a long, thick, wavy mane and tail, a long forelock falling between his eyes, a proudly arched neck, a broad forehead, soft velvety nostrils, gentle, clever amber-brown eyes that look almost human, very expressive ears and shaggy black feathering over his big round hooves. He wears a plain, worn brown leather halter.

characters.name: The Prince
characters.description: The black horse as he really is: a king who was bewitched into a horse. Now he gets his kingdom back and becomes the young king’s neighbour and friend.
characters.look: A tall, broad-shouldered young man of about twenty-five with fair skin, a long, proud face, a high-bridged nose, clever amber-brown eyes, a short, neatly trimmed black beard and long, straight jet-black hair gathered at the nape into a thick tail that hangs down his back like a horse's tail. He wears a long charcoal-black wool tunic with silver embroidery at the collar, a silver-grey cloak fastened with a silver brooch shaped like a horseshoe, black hose and tall black riding boots.

characters.name: The Troll in Man’s Shape
characters.description: A lonely, hospitable master who forbids four rooms and punishes disobedience, revealed as a troll with a deadly crew and a taste for control.
characters.look: An unusually tall, gaunt figure who almost passes for a man: a long, craggy face with a stony grey complexion, a huge knobbly nose, small glinting black eyes under bushy iron-grey eyebrows, a wide, thin-lipped mouth, big pointed ears and a short, bristly iron-grey beard. He has very long arms, huge knobbly hands and enormous flat feet in big black boots, and wears a long black wool coat that reaches his ankles, buttoned with large horn buttons, and a tall, battered black hat.

characters.name: The Princess
characters.description: A keen-eyed royal who notices the garden boy’s hidden beauty, defies court disdain, and holds fast to him when the king turns against them.
characters.look: A lively, kind princess of about nineteen with a round, dimpled face, a small nose, bright hazel eyes, fair rosy skin and two long, heavy dark-brown plaits tied with rose-pink ribbons. She wears a rose-pink dress of fine wool, laced at the bodice, with a lace-edged white neckline and a deep-pink girdle, and a slender silver band set with a small pink stone across her brow.

characters.name: The King
characters.description: A stern ruler who imprisons the garden boy to protect his honor, then depends on an unknown champion in war and finally recognizes the truth through his own handkerchief.
characters.look: A broad, barrel-chested king in his fifties with a square, stern face, a big hooked nose, deep-set dark eyes under heavy black eyebrows and a thick, bushy black beard streaked with grey. He wears a heavy crown of dark iron topped with gold points, a long dark-green wool robe with gold trim, a broad brown leather belt with a big gold buckle and tall black riding boots.

places.name: the Long Hallway
places.look: The long, dim hallway inside a tall old house of smoke-blackened logs: rough log walls, a worn plank floor and low, heavy ceiling beams. Along one wall stand four identical closed plank doors in a row, painted dark oxblood red, each with a black iron ring handle. An iron candle holder hangs on the wall, and a small window of greenish glass sits at the far end.

places.name: the Royal Manor
places.look: A royal manor on a green hillside above a wide bog: big two-storey halls of dark, weathered logs with turf roofs, carved gables and small-paned windows, around a grassy yard with a timber gate. Beside the main hall lies a garden with rows of cabbages and roses and a small summerhouse raised on tall wooden posts, with a steep flight of steps up to it. At one corner of the yard stands a round grey stone prison tower with a single barred window near the top.
